predictedRejections: The check mark is mathematically centered but still looks optically low or small.
Only the screenshot example is fixed while room or card icons remain inconsistent.
A generic CSS rule changes container sizes or breaks mobile layout.
The code passes while the rendered SVG is still clipped or baseline-shifted.
midpoint: Inspect the rendered feature section on one representative vacation listing before broadening verification.
adversarialClose: Measure the icon frame and SVG centers in the browser.
Inspect multiple icon shapes rather than only the check mark.
Confirm no horizontal overflow or clipped SVG bounds.
effectivenessMeasures: center delta no greater than 0.5 CSS pixels
